Day1: DevFest Calabar 2026

Ignite Your Tech Journey - Join us for an unforgettable DevFest Calabar 2026 and ignite your tech journey with a day full of inspiration and innovation! Immerse yourself in the world of technology with engaging talks, hands-on workshops, and networking opportunities with fellow tech enthusiasts. Don't miss this chance to connect, learn, and grow within the vibrant tech community. Whether you're a seasoned developer or just starting out, there's something for everyone. Reserve your spot now and be part of Calabar's tech evolution. Let's build the future together!
